title: Same-Day Payments Counted Against the Portal Bank-Debit Limit, Placed Consumer Accounts
content:
Payments risk memorandum clause for **Placed Consumer Accounts** on which payments received on the handling date are counted against the portal bank-debit limit. One line of the clause reads the account's Payment Arrangements records.

## Clause

The same-day payments counted against the portal bank-debit limit are:
- **every card and bank-debit payment** (debit card, credit card and ACH bank debit) received on the handling date, where any payment plan on the account was closed with close reason "broken, not reinstated";
- **the credit-card and bank-debit payments** received on the handling date, where no plan on the account was so closed and one or more returned payments were received on the account in the last six months;
- **the bank-debit payments** received on the handling date, in every other case.

The same-day payments counted are subtracted from the portal bank-debit limit.

## Reading the clause

- *Closed as broken, not reinstated* is read from the close reason on the Payment Arrangements plan records of the placed account. One such plan, at any date, is enough.
- *Returned payments in the last six months* are the returned-payment entries on the account's money history, of any channel and reason, received fewer than six whole calendar months before the handling date (a whole month being reached on the same day of a later month).
- *Received on the handling date* means consumer payments posted on the account's money history dated the handling date itself.

## Decision table

| Plan on the account closed as broken, not reinstated | Returned payment in the last six months | Same-day payments counted |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | either | Debit-card, credit-card and bank-debit payments of the handling date |
| No | Yes | Credit-card and bank-debit payments of the handling date |
| No | No | Bank-debit payments of the handling date |

## Hypothetical worked case

*Invented records.* On the handling date the account has already received a debit-card payment of $400.00, a credit-card payment of $900.00 and a bank-debit payment of $250.00.

| Situation | Total counted |
|---|---|
| A Long-Term Installment Plan on the account was closed as broken, not reinstated in 2025 | $400.00 plus $900.00 plus $250.00 gives $1550.00 |
| No plan so closed; an NSF return received three months ago | $900.00 plus $250.00 gives $1150.00 |
| No plan so closed; no return in the last six months | $250.00 |
